scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Spicy Southwestern Slaw: cabbage, carrot, onion, bell pepper, jalapeno pepper, coriander, canola oil, apple cider vinegar, white sugar, cayenne pepper, salt pepper.
Step 1 of Spicy Southwestern Slaw: In a large bowl, toss together the cabbage, carrot, onion, red pepper, jalapeno and cilantro. Set aside..

Step 2 of Spicy Southwestern Slaw: In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, sugar, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetable mixture and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour..
